body.statement: In the adaptive-experiment framework of Freidling, Zhao, and Gao, Proposition 2 states that A2--A3 give the conditional-law representation obtained by independent candidate-action resampling restricted to the same selector, while A1 together with imputability of the test statistic, selector, and action mass with respect to \(\mathcal G\) makes that reference distribution computable.

attestation.note: The proposition-level representation and computability claim is recorded with the stable primary-paper handles and the directive-supplied A1--A3 allocation.
